name: Riley
description:
Claude is incredibly powerful—but without business context, it’s like Google Maps without GPS. It can answer questions, but it doesn’t know your customers, revenue, sales process, or what matters most to your business.

Riley transforms fragmented revenue data into the live context Claude needs to become an expert on your company.
Connect Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack, customer emails, product usage, support tickets, documents, call transcripts, and CRM data into a continuously updated intelligence layer. Riley cleans, connects, and understands this information so Claude reasons over your business.

Ask Claude:
 • Which accounts are most likely to expand next quarter?
 • Which deals are off playbook?
 • Why is pipeline slowing in healthcare?
 • What customer themes emerged this week?
 • Which competitors are appearing more frequently?
 • What actions should Customer Success take to improve NRR?

Unlike dashboards that describe what happened, Riley continuously discovers patterns, identifies risks, surfaces opportunities, and keeps Claude updated as your business changes.

Claude is the reasoning engine. Riley is the Revenue Context Layer.
Together, they function like GPS for your revenue organization, helping Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and executives make faster, better decisions based on a complete, continuously evolving understanding of the business

_published_faq.name: How do I add Riley to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Riley to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.askriley.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Riley MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Riley provides these MCP tools: riley_analyze, riley_confirm_ingest_upload, riley_create_dataset, riley_get_analysis_status, riley_get_ingest_status, riley_inline_ingest_upload, riley_list_datasets, and riley_request_ingest_upload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Riley?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Riley in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Riley requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Riley is developed by Riley. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
